title: Fall Creek Farm and Nursery buys Driesvenplant
summary: Trade report, by Matthew Jones, that Fall Creek acquired the Dutch nursery Driesvenplant, extending its European propagation capacity.
why_it_matters: A dated corporate transaction that expands European propagation capacity. Acquisitions of propagation assets are a leading indicator of where a genetics business intends to place volume.

commercial_position.rationale: Owning European propagation capacity materially changes a genetics supplier's cost and speed to market.

monitoring.rationale: Watch for further European nursery consolidation.
